### 1. Scene
A mixed buffet-style meal: leafy bean salad, roasted potatoes and squash, tomato-topped pizza or flatbread, and rice with meat and zucchini.

### 2. Vessel
A square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation, its usable area is **3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm²**.

### 3. Items
Visible foods appear to be spinach/mixed leaves, red kidney beans, shredded carrot, roasted potatoes, skin-on squash, tomato pizza/flatbread, rice, browned meat, and zucchini. A light oily dressing is visible on the salad; roasting oil is included in the cooked vegetable energy estimates.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas are assigned without double-counting overlapping foods. Food covers approximately **90%** of the plate.

| Item | Area share | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Leafy greens | 23% | 122 cm² × 2.6 cm = 317 ml | 0.15 | 48 g | 23 | 11 |
| Kidney beans | 5% | 27 × 1.2 = 32 ml | 0.8 | 26 g | 125 | 33 |
| Shredded carrot | 2% | 11 × 0.9 = 10 ml | 0.6 | 6 g | 41 | 2 |
| Roasted potatoes | 14% | 74 × 2.0 = 148 ml | 0.65 | 96 g | 150 | 144 |
| Roasted squash | 5% | 27 × 2.0 = 54 ml | 0.6 | 32 g | 65 | 21 |
| Tomato pizza/flatbread | 18% | 96 × 1.4 = 134 ml | 0.9 | 121 g | 250 | 303 |
| Cooked rice | 10% | 53 × 1.5 = 80 ml | 0.8 | 64 g | 130 | 83 |
| Cooked meat pieces | 7% | 37 × 1.5 = 56 ml | 0.95 | 53 g | 220 | 117 |
| Zucchini | 6% | 32 × 1.0 = 32 ml | 0.6 | 19 g | 35 | 7 |
| Oily salad dressing | Overlay | Approximately 8 ml | 1.0 | 8 g | 880 | 70 |

The dressing is an overlay, so it adds no separate plate-area share.

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **473 g and approximately 790 kcal**. That is plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate, with substantial roasted vegetables and bread alongside smaller amounts of rice and meat. The greatest uncertainties are the bread thickness and amount of oil.
